Title: Quiz duplicate prevention, source trace and failed-attempt hint
Procedure: Validate all 6,840 questions across 152 species; compare question text across Easy/Medium/Hard; verify source references and unsuccessful-attempt review payload.

Title: Chatbot source links, answer depth and child-friendly terms
Procedure: Run chatbot evidence regressions; verify source links are allow-listed/clickable; exercise complex, vague and terminology-sensitive questions.

Title: Location category, search and List View
Procedure: Open Discover; check seven categories; filter Aquariums; combine with KLCC search; clear/filter; enter an impossible query; inspect list summaries.

Title: Map markers, marker previews and List/Map consistency
Procedure: Grant location if requested; compare result sets between List and Map; select markers and verify previews against list cards.

Title: Location permission decline and coordinate privacy
Procedure: Switch to Map; inspect plain-language permission prompt; choose Not Now; verify continued use and confirm the app states coordinates are not saved.

Title: Approximate distance and nearby comparison
Procedure: Grant location; confirm distance is approximate and consistent in List, Map and detail; compare nearby ordering; revoke permission and recheck.

Title: Enhanced location detail
Procedure: Open Aquaria KLCC; verify address, category, description, why recommended, opening hours, facilities and official website.

Title: Google Maps hand-off and unavailable enhanced fields
Procedure: Use Open in Google Maps and verify destination; open a location with missing optional data and confirm graceful omission/fallback.

Title: Photo authenticity gate and failure handling
Procedure: Exercise authentic, recaptured, external/downloaded, uncertain and service-failure cases; verify combined-signal decisions and age-appropriate guidance.

Title: Upload-only signals and authenticity privacy
Procedure: Verify upload provenance and metadata minimisation; ensure insufficient pixel evidence does not block and technical results are not exposed to children.

Title: Battle onboarding, mode, habitat and card selection
Procedure: Open Battle; inspect rules and mode choice; start Practice vs Bot; verify arena, +20% habitat message, ready/resting deck and one-card selection.

Title: Battle Energy, turns, actions and HP completion
Procedure: Run full battle rules and session regression for starting Energy, costs, locks, one action, recharge, effects and HP-zero completion.

Title: Battle feedback, result, recap and card rest
Procedure: Complete Bot battle; observe HP/Energy/shield, action feedback, result, no-points message, recap, two-hour rest, blocked reuse and elapsed-time recovery contracts.

Title: Friend code and friendship lifecycle
Procedure: Create two users; add by valid code; reject invalid/self code; verify existing friendship, list membership and friend-only invitation restriction.

Title: Friend Battle invitation, shared state, timeout and leaderboard
Procedure: Send, accept and decline invites; complete card selection; verify shared habitat, random starter, 30-second timer, turn skip, synchronisation and leaderboard result.

Title: AI Bot legality, parity, training and evaluation
Procedure: Verify legal actions, engine-only mutation, standard difficulty, zero points and committed training; audit state inputs and representative evaluation/review coverage.

Title: Frontend build and dependency security gate
Procedure: Install locked dependencies; run TypeScript no-emit compile, Expo web export and npm audit.
